notes: Read all 43 source lines (plus the trailing newline) with line numbers before porting. The source is a pure re-export barrel for the web feedback component family; the native port keeps it a pure re-export barrel and imports no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components.

EmptyState (web L2), Skeleton (web L7), and AlertBanner (web L19) are the feedback primitives currently present in apps/native/src/web-parity/components/feedback, so they are the live native re-exports. Each mirrors the web barrel's component-only surface for its line (web L2/L7/L19 export just the component, no types), so the native barrel likewise re-exports only EmptyState, Skeleton, and AlertBanner from their already-ported native siblings.

Every other identifier exported across web L1, L3-L6, L8-L18, L20-L43 maps to a feedback module that has NOT yet been ported into the native parity tree. Re-exporting any of them would point at a missing file and break the native typecheck, so instead all of them are enumerated verbatim in nativeFeedbackBarrelCapabilities.pending.exports with a shared NATIVE_FEEDBACK_PENDING_REASON, giving an explicit unavailable state that keeps the source public API documented and discoverable. This follows the capability-record convention already used by the native charts barrel (nativeChartsBarrelCapabilities).

The pending list accounts for every remaining source identifier including value exports (Spinner L1; ErrorDisplay L3; ErrorBoundary L4; SectionErrorBoundary L5; PageErrorBoundary L6; ChartSkeleton L8; StatSkeleton L9; PageHeaderSkeleton/StatGridSkeleton/ChartBlockSkeleton/TableSkeleton L10-15; PageLoader L16; PageLoadSkeleton L17; QueryError L18; InlineCallout L20; DraftRecoveryBanner L21; DraftRestorePrompt L22; OfflineBanner L23; LiveStaleDataBanner L24; TeslaReauthBanner L25; RateLimitBanner L26; MaintenanceBanner L27; ImpersonationBanner L28; RequiresAuth L29; GotoIndicator L30; KeyboardShortcutsModal L31; TourOverlay L32; JobProgressDrawer L33; AchievementUnlockedToast/AchievementUnlockedToastStack L34; AchievementUnlockListener L35; ChangelogModal L36; TopProgress L37; SuspenseProgressBoundary L38; SkipToContent L39; BrowserCompatBanner L40; TimeMachineBanner L41; EditConflictBanner L42; CookieConsentBanner L43), const exports (requiresAuthEmptyTestId L29; TIME_MACHINE_OPEN_PICKER_EVENT L41), and type-only exports (InlineCalloutProps/CalloutVariant L20; DraftRecoveryBannerProps L21; RequiresAuthProps/RequiresAuthCapability L29; AchievementUnlockedToastProps L34; EditConflictBannerProps L42). Skeleton (web L7) has since been ported and is now a live re-export rather than a pending entry.

No behavior, state names, API paths, unit handling, or i18n strings exist in this barrel to preserve; it carries no browser-only runtime behavior of its own beyond module re-export wiring, which is reproduced faithfully for the ported subset and explicitly deferred for the rest. The trailing blank line (L44) carries no export and needs no port.
